name: pam_usertype
description: Check user type based on login.defs configuration
detailed_description: Account and authentication module that determines and validates user type based on UID ranges defined in /etc/login.defs. Can distinguish between system users and regular users. Useful for conditional authentication and session policies based on user classification.

parameters.issystem: Check if user is a system user (UID < SYS_UID_MAX)
parameters.isregular: Check if user is a regular user (UID >= UID_MIN)
parameters.use_uid: Check UID of user running application instead of authenticated user

notes:
User classification module based on /etc/login.defs; useful for applying different policies to system vs regular users.
